name: Video Design Studio
description: Pre-production design layer for AI video: storyboards with continuity contracts, cinematic shot lists from recipe cards, cross-model text-to-video prompt engineering with structural audit, and reusable visual style anchors with character consistency cards.
description_zh: AI 视频的前期设计层：分镜设计（节拍表 + 逐场景 prompt 对 + 连续性约束表，附机器校验）、12 卡镜头清单设计、跨模型文生视频提示词工程（六槽位结构 + 机器审计）、视觉风格锚与角色一致性卡。方法论借鉴 video-storyboard / video-shotcraft / visual-skills 等开源项目并已署名。
